subject: advanced-maths
title: Advanced Maths — Second Partial (Midterm 2)
note: Two problems of 5 points, as in the 2020 second partials: one on a nonlinear system (equilibria, Jacobian, phase portrait) and one on Fourier series or a PDE solved by separation of variables. The papers print 1 hour (2019), 1.5 hours (2021) and 2 hours (2020); 90 minutes is the standard here.

provenance.structure_source: Read from MATHS_SECONDPARTIAL_2019_MT3 (4+6, 1 hour), 2020 G45/G46/G47 (5+5, 2 hours), 2021 G45 (1.5 hours), 2024, 2025 G46/G47 in sources/cuatrimestre-1/04-advanced-maths/examenes/: always a nonlinear-systems or Fourier-series problem and a PDE problem.
provenance.verify_when: The official duration of the current course's Midterm 2 is confirmed; update this file and drop this note.

content_scope_source: Units 4 to 6: nonlinear systems, Fourier series, and the heat, wave and Laplace equations by separation of variables.

parts.label: Problem 1 — Nonlinear system
parts.description: One problem of 5 points on a nonlinear planar system: equilibria, linearisation, classification and phase portrait.

parts.label: Problem 2 — Fourier series and PDEs
parts.description: One problem of 5 points on a Fourier series with its convergence, or on the heat, wave or Laplace equation by separation of variables.
